 How to watch Iowa State vs UCF
 Date: Friday, November 20, 2026
 Time: 6 PM EDT
 Channel: FOX Sports 1
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 UCF and Iowa State are locked level on 3-4 records in the Big 12 (both 5-5 overall) and fighting for a spot in the bowl picture when they face off on Friday. The Cyclones travel to the Acrisure Bounce House for the first time hoping to spin back-to-back wins for the first time this season after an impressive 41-13 result against Cincinnati last Saturday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Some on the UCF roster will still remember the agony of their only previous run-in with ISU in 2024 when Rocco Becht's touchdown with 30 seconds left on the clock sealed a dramatic 38-25 win in Ames. The Knights have lost two on the road and at home and were outscored by a combined 45 points against Arizona State and Baylor, while the current quarterback picture remains murky.
 Senior Alonza Barnett has impressed in patches during his tenure standing in for Keyone Jenkins, who has been struggling with injuries in recent weeks. James Madison transfer Barnett has thrown for 250-plus yards in back-to-back games against Kansas and ASU while Jenkins has sat out, and Iowa State coach Jimmy Rogers has experience going up against the former during his time with Washington State.
 UCF's defense allows 136.9 rushing yards per game (58th in the FBS) but will be tested by one of the top running backs in the nation, with Aiden Flora's 1,335 yards ranking him No. 1 in the country (with 12 touchdowns to show for it).
